0022600001.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Pistons hosting the Celtics. Detroit won the 2025-26 season series 3-1 and most recently beat Boston 104-103 in Detroit on January 19, 2026. Boston is without Sam Hauser, who is day-to-day, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Pistons a 50% chance to win.
